description: This file defines the Pickup class, a controller for handling the pickup shipping extension in the OpenCart admin panel. It manages rendering the configuration page and saving settings related to the pickup shipping method.

classes.name: Pickup
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Pickup shipping extension configuration in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles display of the Pickup shipping extension settings page, including breadcrumbs, loading geo zones, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Pickup shipping extension settings, including permission check and JSON response.
